description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
